Overview

Procurement & Maintenance with Mowatek

A well-chosen system still needs to be installed, commissioned and looked after. Mowatek supplies equipment and provides the technical services that keep it performing.

Scope is agreed project by project, from a single item of equipment to a complete installation.

Equipment areas

  • Pumps and motors
  • Filtration equipment
  • Disinfection systems
  • Control and monitoring
  • Tanks and vessels
  • Valves and piping
Services

What this includes

Scope is confirmed with you for each project.

Equipment supply

Sourcing equipment suited to the project and the site.

Installation

Mechanical and pipework installation carried out to the project specification.

Commissioning

Starting up and checking systems so they operate as designed.

Preventive maintenance

Planned servicing to help avoid unplanned failures.

Repairs

Diagnosing and repairing faults on existing equipment.

Upgrades

Improving or extending existing systems.

Mowatek at work.

How we work

Dependable solutions start with understanding the problem.

  1. 01

    Understand

    We start with your site, your constraints and what you need the system to achieve.

  2. 02

    Define

    We help shape a fit-for-purpose approach, with technical partners where appropriate.

  3. 03

    Equipment, installation and technical support carried out with attention to site safety.

  4. 04

    Support

    Clear communication through delivery, and technical backup as systems go into use.
